brief: @buildthis.bisks.net A nutty dungeon crawler party roller. Each stats Strength, Intelligence and Agility, a race (human, elf, dwarf, strange stuff), and a class. 4 members in the party. Use a tree-based roller system for whacky backstories for each party member. Odds are, they're not gonna make it
note: four adventurers, str/int/agi, human/elf/dwarf/strange-stuff, a class, and a backstory grown by walking a branching tree. survival odds cap at 94% — the dungeon always wins a little.
